chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Chapter 677: Five Saint Ancestors Descend – War of All Heavens
chapter_meta_description: The Otherworld's five Saint Ancestors descend, triggering an apocalyptic war. Heroes fall as Xiao Chen fights Stone Kings and the Heavenly Emperor City appears.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch. 677: Five Saint Ancestors Descend
og_description: The climactic war engulfs all worlds. Xiao Chen battles Stone Kings while the five Saint Ancestors challenge the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors.
